tips.title: Define CAM-Part
tips.body: Create a CAM-Part with default settings or manually specify name and location.

tips.title: Select CNC-controller
tips.body: Choose a CNC-controller that influences Coordinate System and Geometry definitions.

tips.title: Define Coordinate System
tips.body: Set the origin for all machining operations using model faces, vertices, edges, or Inventor Coordinate Systems.

tips.title: Define Stock model
tips.body: Specify the initial state of the workpiece to be machined.

tips.title: Define Target model
tips.body: Specify the final state of the workpiece after machining.

tips.title: Turn off automatic CAM-Part definition
tips.body: Disable auto-selection of project location and automatic CAM-Part definition to manually control the process.

tips.title: Load Autodesk Inventor model
tips.body: Open the Exercise1.ipt model located in the Exercises folder.

tips.title: Start InventorCAM
tips.body: Activate InventorCAM by clicking the New > Milling option.

tips.title: Select CNC-machine controller
tips.body: Choose a 3-Axis CNC-machine controller for the machining process.

tips.title: Define Machine Coordinate System
tips.body: Set the Z-axis parallel to the revolution axis of the tool and define the origin position.

tips.title: Use associative face method for CoordSys
tips.body: Define a coordinate system by selecting a face that remains associative to the model.

tips.title: Use select face method for CoordSys
tips.body: Define a new CoordSys by selecting a planar or cylindrical/conical face.

tips.title: Use Associative Coordinate System
tips.body: InventorCAM keeps the CAM coordinate system associative with the chosen CAD coordinate system.

tips.title: Save CAM-Part Data
tips.body: Confirm the Milling Part Data dialog box to save the defined CAM-Part.

tips.title: Close CAM-Part
tips.body: Right-click the CAM-Part header in the InventorCAM Manager tree and choose Close.

tips.title: Define face milling geometry
tips.body: Face Milling Geometry can be defined based on the actual Updated Stock boundary or by selecting faces or profiles.

tips.title: Select tool for face milling
tips.body: Choose a suitable tool from the TOOLKIT dialog box, such as a face mill of Ø100 with specified parameters.

tips.title: Define face depth
tips.body: Set the Face depth directly on the solid model, ensuring it is associative with model changes.

tips.title: Choose machining strategy
tips.body: Select the One Pass option in the Technology section for face milling operations.

tips.title: Use One Pass machining technology for face milling
tips.body: InventorCAM automatically calculates the optimal tool movement with the tool covering the whole geometry.

tips.title: Define the angle between the tool path and the geometry
tips.body: Enter the value of angle in the Absolute angle edit box.

tips.title: Use Automatic optimal angle for tool path optimization
tips.body: InventorCAM automatically calculates the optimal angle of hatching to expedite the machining process.

tips.title: Shift the generated tool path from the center of part
tips.body: Enter the distance in the Shift from center edit box.

tips.title: Define the tool path extension over the face edges
tips.body: Select either percentage of the tool diameter or by value.

tips.title: Save and calculate the tool path
tips.body: Click to save the Face Milling operation data and calculate the tool path.

tips.title: Simulate the machining process
tips.body: Click to simulate the Face Milling operation and display all tool paths in one color.

tips.title: Use Profile milling for external profile machining
tips.body: Select Profile from the Add Milling Operation submenu to machine the external profile.

tips.title: Define geometry for Profile operation
tips.body: Select solid model entities for the Geometry definition using the Chain Selection Options.

tips.title: Use Smart Face for selecting geometry from faces
tips.body: Check the Smart Face check box to pick a geometry directly from the face.

tips.title: Define feed and spin parameters for Profile milling
tips.body: Set the Spin rate, Feed XY, Feed Z, and optionally different values for Feed finish.

tips.title: Define milling levels for Profile operation
tips.body: Set the Upper level, Lower level, and Step down values using solid model data.

tips.title: Define upper and lower levels for machining
tips.body: Select 'By stock', 'By target', or 'User defined' in the Variable levels dialog box.

tips.title: Set step down for roughing
tips.body: Define the Step down parameter to set the distance between each Z-level during roughing.

tips.title: Define wall and floor offsets
tips.body: Set Wall offset and Floor offset parameters to define allowances left on the walls and floor of the machined part.

tips.title: Choose lead-in and lead-out strategies
tips.body: Select from None, Normal, Arc, Tangent, Point, or User-defined for tool approach and retreat.

tips.title: Define machining strategy for pocketing
tips.body: Select Contour, Inside, Outside, Fillet, Loop, or Sharp in the Contour parameters.

tips.title: Define Ramping Strategy for Pocket Milling
tips.body: Select a ramping strategy from None, Vertical, Angle, Helical, or Linear in the Pocket Operation dialog box.

tips.title: Configure Helical Ramping Parameters
tips.body: Set Tool step down, Angle, and Radius parameters in the Helical Ramping Parameters section.

tips.title: Select Lead In and Lead Out Strategy
tips.body: Choose from None, Normal, Arc, or Tangent for Lead in and Lead out strategies in the Pocket Lead in and Lead out section.

tips.title: Define Pre-Drill Operations
tips.body: Select a drill operation from the list and define X- and Y-coordinates in the Drill positions list.

tips.title: Set Tool for Drilling Operation
tips.body: Select a Spot drill tool from the TOOLKIT window and set spin rate to 1200 and Feed Z to 200.

tips.title: Define Center Drilling Depth
tips.body: Set the Depth type to Diameter value and enter a value between 0 and the drill tool diameter.

tips.title: Calculate Centering Depth
tips.body: Use the formula Centering_depth = Diameter_value / 2 * tan(α/2) to calculate centering depth.

tips.title: Simulate operations in SolidVerify
tips.body: Perform simulations to ensure correct operation paths and toolpaths before actual machining.

tips.title: Add a Drilling operation
tips.body: Right-click the last operation and select 'Drilling' from the Add Milling Operation submenu.

tips.title: Define drill geometry
tips.body: Select the appropriate drill geometry from the list in the Geometry area.

tips.title: Set drill tool parameters
tips.body: Define spin rate and feed Z in the Tool page of the Drilling Operation dialog box.

tips.title: Define drilling depth
tips.body: Set the Upper level and Drill depth on the Levels page, adjusting Delta for stock offset.

tips.title: Select drilling type
tips.body: Use the Peck canned cycle for chip breaking in the Technology page.

tips.title: Define pecking parameters
tips.body: Set Step down to 1.5 in the Drill options dialog box.

tips.title: Calculate tool path
tips.body: Click to save the Drilling operation data and calculate the tool path.

tips.title: Load Inventor model
tips.body: Load the Exercise3.ipt model from the Exercises folder.

tips.title: Define Part Lower level
tips.body: Set the Part Lower level directly on the solid model by selecting the lower face.

tips.title: Define Face Milling operation
tips.body: Right-click the Operations header in InventorCAM Manager and choose 'Face' from the Add Milling Operation submenu.

tips.title: Select tool for Face Milling operation
tips.body: Define a new Face mill of Ø40 and edit parameters: Shoulder length = 27.5, Cutting length = 10.

tips.title: Set Face depth for Face Milling operation
tips.body: Switch to the Levels page and select the model face as the Face depth.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for Face Milling operation
tips.body: Switch to the Technology page and use the Hatch option with automatic optimal angle, one-way cutting direction, side-to-side cutting order, 30% overlap, equal step over, and a floor offset of 0.2.

tips.title: Define Lead in and Lead out for Face Milling operation
tips.body: Switch to the Link page, use the default Tangent option with a length of 5 for Lead in, and select 'Same as Lead in' for Lead out.

tips.title: Save and Calculate Face Milling operation
tips.body: Click 'Calculate' to save the Face Milling operation data and calculate the tool path.

tips.title: Simulate Face Milling operation
tips.body: Click 'Simulate' to start the simulation in SolidVerify and close it after viewing.

tips.title: Add Profile operation
tips.body: Right-click the Operations header in InventorCAM Manager and choose 'Profile' from the Add Milling Operation submenu to define a Profile operation.

tips.title: Select tool for Profile Operation
tips.body: Add a new End mill tool of Ø16 with CAT40 adaptor and BT40 ER32×60 collet chuck.

tips.title: Define profile depth for Profile Operation
tips.body: Set the profile depth by clicking on model faces in the Levels page.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for Profile Operation
tips.body: Set tool side to Right, define offsets and step downs in the Technology page.

tips.title: Define lead-in and lead-out for Profile Operation
tips.body: Set Tangent option in Lead-in section with Length value of 12, use Same as Lead-in in Lead-out section.

tips.title: Save and calculate Profile operation
tips.body: Click the Save button to save data and Calculate to generate tool path.

tips.title: Simulate Profile operation
tips.body: Click the Simulate button to start simulation and measure distances using SolidVerify.

tips.title: Define geometry for new Profile operation
tips.body: Select model edges and create chains using the Chains Selection dialog box.

tips.title: Select tool for new Profile operation
tips.body: Use the same tool as in previous operations (Ø16 End mill).

tips.title: Define profile depth for new Profile operation
tips.body: Set the profile depth by clicking on model faces in the Levels page.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for new Profile operation
tips.body: Set tool side to Right, define offsets and step downs in the Technology page.

tips.title: Define lead-in and lead-out for new Profile operation
tips.body: Set Arc option in Lead-in section with Radius value of 12, use Same as Lead-in in Lead-out section.

tips.title: Save and calculate new Profile operation
tips.body: Click the Save button to save data and Calculate to generate tool path.

tips.title: Simulate new Profile operation
tips.body: Click the Simulate button to start simulation and measure distances using SolidVerify.

tips.title: Define milling levels for new Profile operation
tips.body: Set the machining level to start at the Z-level of already machined faces.

tips.title: Define a new Coordinate System
tips.body: Double-click the CoordSys Manager header in InventorCAM Manager and set Mac CoordSys number to 2.

tips.title: Select face mode for new Coordinate System
tips.body: Choose Select face mode to define a new Coordinate System by selecting a planar face.

tips.title: Place Coordinate System origin
tips.body: Set the Place CoordSys origin to Top corner of model box option.

tips.title: Set workpiece origin
tips.body: Move the origin of the Coordinate System to the corner of the workpiece.

tips.title: Define geometry for Face Milling
tips.body: Choose the Machine Coordinate System #2 and define the geometry with a 3 mm offset.

tips.title: Define milling levels for Face Milling
tips.body: Set the Upper level to Z=0 and the Lower level to Z=-5 of Machine Coordinate System #2.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for Face Milling
tips.body: Use the Hatch option with an overlap of 30% and a floor offset of 0.2.

tips.title: Define lead-in and lead-out for Face Milling
tips.body: Use the Tangent option with a length of 5 for lead-in, and the Same as Lead in check box for lead-out.

tips.title: Add a Pocket operation for rough machining
tips.body: Create a new Pocket operation to machine the upper part of the pocket down to the pads height.

tips.title: Define geometry for Pocket operation
tips.body: Choose the Machine Coordinate System #2 and define the geometry with Constant Z Propagation.

tips.title: Select tool for Pocket operation
tips.body: Use the Ø16 End mill defined for pocket rough machining.

tips.title: Define pocket depth for Pocket operation
tips.body: Set the Pocket depth to the top face of the pads with a Step down value of 2.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for Pocket operation
tips.body: Set the Wall offset and Floor offset to 0.2.

tips.title: Define ramping strategy for Pocket operation
tips.body: Use the Helical option with a Radius of 3.

tips.title: Define lead-out for Pocket operation
tips.body: Use the Arc option with a Radius of 2.

tips.title: Add a Pocket operation for bottom part of pocket
tips.body: Create a new Pocket operation to machine the bottom part of the pocket including two islands.

tips.title: Define geometry for bottom Pocket operation
tips.body: Choose the Machine Coordinate System #2 and define the multi-chain geometry by clicking on the pocket bottom face.

tips.title: Select tool for bottom Pocket operation
tips.body: Use the Ø16 End mill defined for the operation.

tips.title: Define milling levels for bottom Pocket operation
tips.body: Set the Upper level to the top face of the pads and the Lower level to the bottom face of the pocket.

tips.title: Set step down to 2
tips.body: Step down: 2

tips.title: Choose default Contour option in Technology section
tips.body: Default option: Contour

tips.title: Set Wall, Island, and Floor offsets to 0.2
tips.body:
Wall offset: 0.2
Island offset: 0.2
Floor offset: 0.2

tips.title: Choose Helical option for Ramping strategy
tips.body:
Ramping strategy: Helical
Radius of descent helix: 3

tips.title: Choose Arc option for Lead out strategy
tips.body:
Lead out strategy: Arc
Radius value: 2

tips.title: Define new tool for operation
tips.body: Tool: CAT40 adaptor, BT40 ER32x60 collet chuck

tips.title: Set Rest material parameters for previous tool
tips.body:
Rest option: Rest
Previous tool diameter: 16mm
Extension/Overlap: 1

tips.title: Use Equal step down option for Profile operation
tips.body:
Step down: Max step down
Max step down value: 3
Depth type: Helical

tips.title: Choose Normal option for Lead in strategy
tips.body:
Lead in strategy: Normal
Normal length value: 5

tips.title: Choose Arc option for Lead out strategy in Profile operation
tips.body:
Lead out strategy: Same as Lead in
Radius value: 2

tips.title: Define new Face Milling operation for top faces of pads
tips.body: Geometry: Coordinate System #2 (MAC 2)

tips.title: Define separate chains for each face
tips.body: In the Face Milling Geometry dialog box, click the Separate button in the Chain List section to create two separate chains for machining different faces separately.

tips.title: Choose appropriate tool for the operation
tips.body: Select Ø8 End mill for face milling and Ø6 End mill for pocket milling operations.

tips.title: Define milling levels directly on the solid model
tips.body: Click on the top face of the pad to define the Upper level for face milling and on the bottom face of the pocket for pocket milling.

tips.title: Use One Pass strategy for contour milling
tips.body: In the Technology page, choose the One Pass strategy for contour milling operations.

tips.title: Set wall and island offsets for pocket milling
tips.body: In the Offsets section, set the Wall offset and Island offset values to 0.1 to prevent tool contact with already machined surfaces.

tips.title: Define slot geometry and tool parameters
tips.body: Choose Machine Coordinate System #2 for the operation, define the geometry for the slot as shown, and edit tool parameters to use CAT40 adaptor and BT40 ER16x70 collet chuck.

tips.title: Set slot depth and step down value
tips.body: Define the slot depth directly on the solid model, set the Step down value to 0.5 for climb milling.

tips.title: Define drilling geometry and tool parameters
tips.body: Choose Machine Coordinate System #2 for the operation, click to start drill position definition, and define a new SPOT DRILL tool with CAT40 adaptor and ER16x70 holder.

tips.title: Set drilling depth and diameter for center drilling
tips.body: Define the Drill depth to 0, use Diameter value option in Depth type section, set the value to 5.5 mm.

tips.title: Define drilling depth and diameter for through drilling
tips.body: Set the Delta value to -1, use Full diameter option in Depth type section, set the value to 5.5 mm.

tips.title: Set pecking parameters for drilling
tips.body: Click the Drill cycle type button, choose Peck type, set Step down value for pecking to 0.5.

tips.title: Define a new drilling operation
tips.body: Choose drill1 geometry and select Ø2 T aptool with CAT40 adaptor and ER 16x703 holder.

tips.title: Set drilling depth
tips.body: Define the Upper level and set Drill depth to 4.

tips.title: Save and calculate tool path
tips.body: Click to save the Drilling operation data and calculate the tool path.

tips.title: Simulate multiple operations
tips.body: Hold Shift and select the last three operations to play the simulation.

tips.title: Generate G-code
tips.body: Right-click the Operations header and choose Generate from the GCode All submenu.

tips.title: Face milling operation
tips.body: Define a Face Milling operation to machine the top face of the bracket.

tips.title: Profile machining operation
tips.body: Perform Profile rough and finish machining of the bracket side faces.

tips.title: Pocket machining operation
tips.body: Define a Pocket operation to perform rough and finish machining of the pocket located on the top face.

tips.title: Drilling operations for cylindrical hole
tips.body: Define two Drilling operations for center drilling and preliminary drilling.

tips.title: Pocket operations for cylindrical hole
tips.body: Perform two Pocket operations to machine the faces of the through hole.

tips.title: Drilling operations for holes
tips.body: Define a number of Drilling operations to perform center drilling, drilling, and tapping.

tips.title: Face milling operation for bottom face
tips.body: Define a Face Milling operation to machine the bottom face of the bracket using the Hatch strategy.

tips.title: Define new Coordinate System for bottom face
tips.body: Define and use a new Coordinate System with the Z-axis oriented normally to the bottom face.

tips.title: Define CAM-Part for electronic box
tips.body: Define the CAM-Part, CNC-controller (gMilling_3x), Machine Coordinate System, Stock, and Target models.

tips.title: Face milling operation for electronic box
tips.body: Define a Face Milling operation to machine the top face of the electronic box part with the Hatch strategy.

tips.title: Profile operations for electronic box
tips.body: Define two Profile operations to perform rough machining of the external faces.

tips.title: Pocket operations for electronic box
tips.body: Define two Pocket operations to perform rough machining of the internal pocket faces with a tool of large diameter.

tips.title: Finish machining of internal pocket faces
tips.body: Define a number of Pocket operations to perform finish machining of the internal pocket faces.

tips.title: Rest material machining for internal pocket faces
tips.body: During the wall finish machining, use the Rest Material strategy to remove the bulk of material in the corners.

tips.title: Finish machining of external faces
tips.body: At the first stage, perform the rest material machining of the corner faces to remove the bulk of the material.

tips.title: Profile operations for external faces
tips.body: Define a number of Profile operations to machine the external faces.

tips.title: Drilling operations for electronic box holes
tips.body: Define a number of Drilling operations to perform center drilling, drilling, and tapping.

tips.title: Pocket operation for counterboring holes
tips.body: Use a Pocket operation for counterboring of the holes.

tips.title: Face milling operation for electronic box bottom face
tips.body: Define a Face Milling operation to machine the bottom face of the electronic box part using the Hatch strategy.

tips.title: Define new Coordinate System for electronic box bottom face
tips.body: Define and use a new Coordinate System with the Z-axis oriented normally to the bottom face.

tips.title: Define CAM-Part for clamp part
tips.body: Define the CAM-Part, CNC-controller (gMilling_3x), Machine Coordinate System, Stock, and Target models.

tips.title: Holes machining for clamp part
tips.body: Perform a number of Drilling operations to machine the holes.

tips.title: Define Machine Coordinate System for clamp part
tips.body: Use the appropriate Machine Coordinate System defined for the positioning shown below.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for open pocket machining
tips.body: Add a new Pocket operation and select the open pocket geometry chain.

tips.title: Close Chain dialog box for open pocket machining
tips.body: Mark the connecting line as an open edge and confirm with OK.

tips.title: Select the correct tool for pocket machining
tips.body: Choose the Ø6 End mill for the operation.

tips.title: Set offsets for pocket machining
tips.body: In the Offsets section, set Wall offset and Floor offset to 0.2.

tips.title: Use Profile Strategy for open pocket machining
tips.body: Select the Use profile strategy check box to perform the open pocket machining in a Profile manner.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for step machining
tips.body: Use the Point to point option in the Geometry Edit dialog box to define the geometry.

tips.title: Use Zigzag method for Depth cutting type
tips.body: Select the Zigzag method for Depth cutting type to connect successive Z-level passes directly.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for external contour machining
tips.body: Use the Point to point option in the Geometry Edit dialog box to define the geometry.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for connector opening machining
tips.body: Use the Point to point option in the Geometry Edit dialog box to define the geometry.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for connector pocket machining
tips.body: Use the Point to point option in the Geometry Edit dialog box to define the geometry.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for connector opening finish machining
tips.body: Use the Point to point option in the Geometry Edit dialog box to define the geometry.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for machine screw head areas
tips.body: Use the Point to point option in the Geometry Edit dialog box to define the geometry.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for top face machining
tips.body: Use the Face milling Hatch strategy to perform the rough and finish machining of the top face.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for bottom face machining
tips.body: Use the Face milling Hatch strategy to perform the rough and finish machining of the bottom face.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for pocket rough machining
tips.body: Use a Pocket operation to perform the rough machining of the highlighted faces.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for wall finish machining
tips.body: Use two Profile operations to perform the finish machining of the wall faces.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for bottom pocket machining
tips.body: Perform the rough and finish machining of the bottom pocket with the island.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for hole machining
tips.body: Define a number of Drilling operations to machine holes located on the cover part faces.

tips.title: Set wall offset for roughing
tips.body: 0.2 mm allowance on hole walls during roughing, removed with finishing cut.

tips.title: Define step down for rough passes
tips.body: Set Step down to 2 for three equidistant rough passes.

tips.title: Define step down for finishing pass
tips.body: Set Step down to 6 for a single pass finishing cut.

tips.title: Use arc for lead in and out
tips.body: Choose Arc option with default Radius value of 2 for both lead in and lead out.

tips.title: Simulate operations in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Perform simulation to check toolpath and machine capabilities.

tips.title: Define geometry chain for profile operation
tips.body: Create a geometry chain on the external faces of the mounting base.

tips.title: Define geometry chain for face milling operation
tips.body: Create a geometry chain on the top face of the mounting base.

tips.title: Define geometry chain for pocket operation
tips.body: Use lower edges of islands for internal chains definition.

tips.title: Set draft angle for inclined wall machining
tips.body: Select Wall draft angle option and set External wall angle to 8.

tips.title: Define geometry chain for T-slot machining
tips.body: Create two geometry chains as shown on the illustration.

tips.title: Set cutting length for slot mill tool
tips.body: Edit tool parameters: Diameter = 36, Corner radius = 0, Cutting length = 3.

tips.title: Define ceiling level for T-slot machining
tips.body: Click on the model face to define the Ceiling (Upper level) for slot machining.

tips.title: Define depth for T-slot machining
tips.body: Click on the model to define the Depth of the T-slot.

tips.title: Set offsets for rough machining of slot
tips.body: Set all offsets to 0.2 for wall, ceiling, and floor.

tips.title: Set cutting depth overlap for finishing pass
tips.body: Set Cutting depth overlap value to 2 for the finishing pass.

tips.title: Use tangent for lead in and out
tips.body: Select Tangent option with Tangent extension set to 12 for lead in, Same as Lead in for lead out.

tips.title: Simulate T-slot operation in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Perform simulation to check toolpath and machine capabilities for T-slot machining.

tips.title: Define drilling operations for countersink holes
tips.body: Create multiple drilling operations to machine countersink holes on the top face of the mounting plate.

tips.title: Add a Thread Milling Operation
tips.body: Create a new Thread Milling operation for threading internal surfaces.

tips.title: Define Geometry for Threading
tips.body: Click on the internal surface of the part to define the geometry.

tips.title: Select Thread Mill Tool
tips.body: Choose the Thread Mill tool from the TOOLKIT and configure its parameters.

tips.title: Create Shaped Tool for Threading
tips.body: Add a shaped tool with cones and cylinders to the Tool Library.

tips.title: Define Milling Levels
tips.body: Set the Upper level directly on the solid model and define Thread depth.

tips.title: Define Technological Parameters
tips.body: Select Internal type, set Major thread diameter, and configure Cut from section.

tips.title: Define Lead In/Out Arc
tips.body: Clear the Start from the center check box for Lead in/out arc.

tips.title: Simulate Operation
tips.body: Perform simulations in Host CAD and SolidVerify modes.

tips.title: Add Another Thread Milling Operation for Small Internal Threads
tips.body: Create a new Thread Milling operation for small internal threads.

tips.title: Define Geometry for Small Internal Threads
tips.body: Click on the upper surface of the model containing the holes to define geometry.

tips.title: Select New Thread Mill Tool for Small Internal Threads
tips.body: Define a new Thread mill with specific parameters.

tips.title: Define Milling Levels for Small Internal Threads
tips.body: Set the Upper level and define Thread depth.

tips.title: Define Technological Parameters for Small Internal Threads
tips.body: Select Internal type and configure Major thread diameter.

tips.title: Define Lead In/Out Arc for Small Internal Threads
tips.body: Select the Start from the center check box for Lead in/out arc.

tips.title: Simulate Operation for Small Internal Threads
tips.body: Perform simulations in SolidVerify mode.

tips.title: Add Thread Milling Operation for External Surface Threading
tips.body: Create a new Thread Milling operation for external surface threading.

tips.title: Define Geometry for External Surface Threading
tips.body: Use the drill geometry defined in the first operation.

tips.title: Define New Thread Mill Tool for External Surface Threading
tips.body: Create a new Thread mill with specific parameters.

tips.title: Define Milling Levels for External Surface Threading
tips.body: Set the Upper level and define Thread depth.

tips.title: Define Technological Parameters for External Surface Threading
tips.body: Select Internal type and configure Major thread diameter.

tips.title: Define Lead In/Out Arc for External Surface Threading
tips.body: Select the Start from the center check box for Lead in/out arc.

tips.title: Simulate Operation for External Surface Threading
tips.body: Perform simulations in SolidVerify mode.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for threading
tips.body: Set Nominal value to 86 in Thread data area and choose Top to bottom option in Cut from area.

tips.title: Set lead-in parameters for threading
tips.body: Under Lead in/out arc, set Arc radius value to 2.

tips.title: Define geometry for engraving operation
tips.body: Select Faces option in Type section and use Loops filter to exclude external chains.

tips.title: Select engraving tool for operation
tips.body: Choose Engraving tool with parameters: Tip diameter = 0.1, Taper angle = 15.

tips.title: Define milling levels for engraving
tips.body: Set Upper level on part surface and Engraving depth on floor of engraved text.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for engraving
tips.body: Choose Fill area option and Contour from list in Modify section, set Step over value to 0.05.

tips.title: Define geometry for second engraving operation
tips.body: Draw a rectangle to define text frame and type in text, adjust properties using toolbar icons.

tips.title: Define milling levels for second engraving operation
tips.body: Set Engraving depth value to 0.2.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for second engraving operation
tips.body: Choose Center in T ool sidelist to position tool tip exactly on geometry.

tips.title: Define CoordSys Positions
tips.body: Add positions around the Machine Coordinate System, ensuring each position is defined relative to the Machine Coordinate System.

tips.title: Set facet tolerance for target model
tips.body: Facet tolerance value to 0.01

tips.title: Add clamp model to CAM-Part assembly
tips.body: Copy clamp model files into the CAM-Part folder before insertion.

tips.title: Align clamp model in CAM-Part assembly
tips.body: Align the model as shown.

tips.title: Edit machine setup in InventorCAM Manager
tips.body: Right-click the Setup > Edit menu to open the Machine setup window.

tips.title: Add associative fixture to machine setup
tips.body: Double-click the Associative Fixture icon to add it below Station_1.

tips.title: Set Z value for fixture in machine setup
tips.body: Click and set the Z value as 35.

tips.title: Expand associative fixture and set part mounting
tips.body: Expand Associative Fixture and click Part Mounting, ensuring the Z value is set as 35.

tips.title: Select fixture in machine setup
tips.body: Click to select the fixture.

tips.title: Visualize fixture on part in machine preview
tips.body: Click the Machine Preview icon to visualize the fixture mounted on the part.

tips.title: Save and exit machine setup
tips.body: Close the Machine Preview window and click Save & Exit.

tips.title: Define pocket operation for rough machining
tips.body: Choose Coordinate System Position #1, define geometry, choose tool and holder.

tips.title: Set pocket depth and offsets
tips.body: Define Pocket depth on top face, set Wall offset and Floor offset to 0.2.

tips.title: Use helical ramping strategy for pocket operation
tips.body: Select Helical Ramping strategy with Radius value set to 5.

tips.title: Define profile operation for finish machining
tips.body: Choose Coordinate System Position #1, use geometry from previous steps, choose tool.

tips.title: Set clear offset and step over for profile operation
tips.body: Set Clear offset and Step over values to perform machining in several concentric profiles.

tips.title: Use arc strategy for lead in and out
tips.body: Choose Arc strategy for Lead in and select Same as Lead in check box under Lead out.

tips.title: Define pocket operation for connector openings
tips.body: Choose Coordinate System Position #4, define geometry, choose tool and holder.

tips.title: Define pocket operation for highlighted pocket faces
tips.body: Choose Coordinate System Position #2, define geometry, choose tool.

tips.title: Select wall and floor for pocket wall finishing
tips.body: In the Finish section of the Technology page, select Wall and Floor check boxes.

tips.title: Set wall finishing options
tips.body: Under Depth, choose Each step down option for wall finishing.

tips.title: Define drilling operations for center drilling, drilling, and threading
tips.body: Use Coordinate System Position #1 for M3 holes with a Ø6 spot drill, Ø2.5 drill, and Ø3 tap tool. Use Coordinate System Position #2 for M6 holes with a Ø6 spot drill, Ø5 drill, and Ø6 tap tool.

tips.title: Set chamfer depth for Profile operation
tips.body: For a 0.5 mm chamfer, set the Chamfer depth to 0.5 in the Profile depth field.

tips.title: Define a circular pattern of operations using the 4th axis
tips.body: Select all defined operations, right-click and choose Transform, then select Edit operation transformations. Set rotation angle to 120° and steps to 2.

tips.title: Define Machine Coordinate Systems for 4-axis machining
tips.body: Define Machine Coordinate System #1 in the center of revolution face and Machine Coordinate System #2 for back faces.

tips.title: Simulate tool path in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Play simulation of transformed operations in SolidVerify mode to check for possible gouges.

tips.title: Define Machine Coordinate Systems for 5-axis machining
tips.body: Define Machine Coordinate Systems #1 and #2 with related positions around the Machine CoordSys.

tips.title: Define operations for clamp machining on 5-axis vertical milling CNC-machine
tips.body: Define Face Milling, Profile, and Pocket operations using Machine Coordinate Systems #1 and #2.

tips.title: Define a new geometry for ToolBox Cycles operations
tips.body: Select a pair of chains as shown and confirm the geometry.

tips.title: Set Wall offset for Spiral Open Slot
tips.body: Under Offsets, set Wall offset to 0.5.

tips.title: Set % of tool diameter for Spiral Open Slot
tips.body: Under Extension, set % of tool diameter to 80.

tips.title: Select Wall finish option for Spiral Open Slot
tips.body: Under Finish, select the Wall finish option.

tips.title: Define a new geometry for Wide Spiral Open Slot
tips.body: Select a pair of chains on the wide slot edges and confirm the geometry.

tips.title: Set Wall offset for Wide Spiral Open Slot
tips.body: Under Offsets, set Wall offset to 1.

tips.title: Select Wall finish option for Wide Spiral Open Slot
tips.body: Under Finish, select the Wall finish option.

tips.title: Define a new geometry for Wide Spiral Closed Slot
tips.body: Select the open chain as shown and confirm the geometry.

tips.title: Select Wall finish option for Wide Spiral Closed Slot
tips.body: Under Finish, select the Wall finish option.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cyclesoperation
tips.body: Under Technology, select the desired strategy (e.g., Additional Zigzag Slot). Define a new geometry and tool.

tips.title: Set Step down for Closed Slot machining
tips.body: In the Closed Slot cycle, set the Step down to 10.

tips.title: Set Approach distance for Open slot machined by rolling
tips.body: Under Extension, set the Approach distance to 1.25.

tips.title: Set Tolerance for Spine Slot machining
tips.body: In the Technology page, set the Tolerance to 1.

tips.title: Set Clear offset for Temporary Bridges machining
tips.body: Under Clear offset, set the Offset to 30.

tips.title: Set Step over for Surface flattening on cylinder
tips.body: On the Technology page, in the Clear offset section, set the Step over value to 3.

tips.title: Set Max step down for Angled cylinder machining
tips.body: In the Technology page, set the Max step down to 4.

tips.title: Set Offset for Thin Wall Machining
tips.body: Edit manually the Offset value to 28.

tips.title: Define pocket recognition filters
tips.body: Select 'Through Pocket' and set 'Apply filter' for circular pocket diameter filter.

tips.title: Set minimum diameter for pocket recognition
tips.body: Enter the value in the 'Min. Diameter' edit box or pick a cylindrical surface on the solid model.

tips.title: Select geometry mode for pocket recognition
tips.body: Choose 'Solid Body' mode to perform automatic recognition of pocket features on the picked solid body.

tips.title: Define machining levels for pocket operation
tips.body: Set 'Upper level' by clicking on the upper model face and select 'Equal step down' with Max step down value of 5.

tips.title: Select approach strategy for open pockets
tips.body: Switch to 'Open pocket' page and select 'Approach from outside' check box.

tips.title: Define external contour machining operation
tips.body: Create a Profile operation for rough machining of the external contour using an End mill tool of Ø20.

tips.title: Define pocket roughing operation
tips.body: Create a Pocket Recognition operation for removing bulk material using an End mill tool of Ø20.

tips.title: Define pocket rest material machining operation
tips.body: Create another Pocket Recognition operation for rest material machining using an End mill tool of Ø10.

tips.title: Define drill recognition parameters
tips.body: Select holes with Through and Blind check boxes, filter by diameter range (e.g., From: 40 mm, To: 42 mm), ensure Hole Upper level and Hole height check boxes are not selected.

tips.title: Set tool parameters for spot drill
tips.body: Add a Spot drill tool of Ø16 with Total length: 70, Outside holder length: 60, Shoulder length: 50.

tips.title: Define milling levels for drills
tips.body: Edit Milling Levels parameters (Upper Level, Drill Depth, Delta Depth) for each drill group separately.

tips.title: Sort drill positions using advanced sorting
tips.body: Choose Advanced option in Sorting, set Tolerance to 5, select Linear pattern with minimal X- and Y-coordinates as start position.

tips.title: Simulate operation in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Click to simulate the operation in SolidVerify mode.

tips.title: Add a new Drill Recognition operation
tips.body: Select 'Drill Recognition' from the operations menu and configure it to recognize holes of specific diameters.

tips.title: Set the range for Hole Diameter filter
tips.body: In the HR Drill Geometry Selection dialog box, activate the 'Hole Diameter' section and set the diameter values in both 'From' and 'To' edit boxes.

tips.title: Add a new Drill tool
tips.body: Create a new drill tool with the appropriate diameter, ensuring it is smaller than the hole diameter for reaming.

tips.title: Set drilling parameters
tips.body: In the 'Levels' page, set the 'Upper Level' and 'Drill Depth' parameters. These values are recognized automatically on the model.

tips.title: Sort drill positions using Advanced sort option
tips.body: In the 'Technology' page, choose the 'Advanced' option under Sorting and select the 'Linear' tab to sort drill positions based on X and Y coordinates.

tips.title: Choose Peck cycle type for drilling
tips.body: Under the 'Drill cycle' section, select the 'Peck' cycle type and set the 'Step down value' to 2.

tips.title: Set chamfer recognition filters
tips.body: Select 'Apply filter' check box and set 'Circular Pocket diameter filter'. Set 'Min. Diameter' to 20.

tips.title: Define geometry selection mode
tips.body: Under 'Selection mode', use the default 'Solid Body' option.

tips.title: Select tool parameters for chamfer operation
tips.body: Set 'Total length' to 100, 'Outside holder length' to 60, and choose the HSK A 63 ER 40x80 collect chuck.

tips.title: Define machining levels for chamfer
tips.body: Set 'Chamfer depth' to 0.5.

tips.title: Set technological parameters for chamfer operation
tips.body: Set 'Cutting diameter' to 2.

tips.title: Define safety offset for open chains
tips.body: Set 'Safety offset' to 2.

tips.title: Set link in and link out parameters
tips.body: Select 'Normal' option from 'Lead in list' and set 'Normal length' to 3. Select 'Same as Lead in' check box in 'Lead out section'.
